profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Developer with experience in software design, development and implementation. I have been exposed to various programming languages, methodologies, frameworks, and libraries. My aim is to excel as an efficient and dynamic software professional and bring my knowledge and skills to bear for my organization's growth

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in Architectural decisions related to change/request in existing applications.
Handled bugs, implemented enhancements and complete new features for the existing applications.
 Restructured and implemented the entire user interface layer of a web application (MyReceipts ‐ www.myreceipts.com )
migrating from the previous JSP implementation to use Struts and Tiles frameworks.
 Re‐implemented the complete look and feel of existing web applications.
Actively interviewing new Software Developer applicants for the company new openings.
